commitResults.messageBody:
The project lacks reusable workflows for reviewing changes visually and
writing consistent commit messages.

Add a split-view HTML diff generator and companion commit-message skill.
These tools keep future reviews aligned with project conventions.

Course requirements need to guide Java changes and Git commits without
adding checks to unrelated work.

Add concise project instructions, a scoped Java convention validator,
and course-aware commit-message guidance so required standards are
applied at the relevant workflow boundaries.

Nudge is in the unnamed package, and its public entry point lacks the
documentation required by the course standard.

Move the class into the nudge package, complete its Javadocs, and
update the setup instructions so Java tools and users address the
qualified main class consistently.

commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce a Todo subtype to distinguish tasks without dates while reusing the existing completion behavior.

Parse todo commands and record UI coverage for adding, listing, marking, and unmarking todo tasks.

Define project guidance for maintaining and running command-line UI tests.

Add a reusable skill that records exact expected output and stops at the first mismatch.

Introduce a Deadline subtype so tasks retain due information while
reusing the existing completion behavior.

Parse /by details and add UI coverage for adding, listing, and marking
deadline tasks.

Introduce an Event subtype so tasks retain start and end times while
reusing the existing completion behavior.

Parse /from and /to details and add UI coverage for adding, listing,
and marking event tasks.

Give task additions a Nudge-specific confirmation and report the
updated count with correct singular and plural wording.

Update UI coverage for every task type and the multi-task count.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle basic input errors with exceptions
commitResults.messageBody:
Add NudgeException and catch expected input errors in the command
loop. Reject unknown commands and todos without descriptions so
invalid input cannot create tasks or terminate the application.

Reject missing, non-numeric, and out-of-range task numbers before
accessing the task array. This lets mark and unmark report actionable
errors without changing task state.

Reject missing descriptions, delimiters, and date or time values before
creating structured tasks. Specific guidance helps users correct
malformed commands without changing the task list.

Centralize task insertion and reject additions after the fixed 100-task
capacity is reached. This prevents array access failures while
preserving the existing list and keeping Nudge responsive.

Replace fixed-capacity array storage with an ArrayList so the task list
can grow dynamically and expose collection operations needed by later
task management commands.

Update UI coverage to verify that task 101 can be added and marked.

Allow users to delete tasks by their displayed numbers. Confirm the
removed task and remaining count, while reusing existing index
validation to keep invalid delete commands from changing the list.

Add UI coverage for deletion, renumbering, count grammar, and invalid
indices.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use enums to make command types explicit
Batch UI tests with compact fixtures
commitResults.messageBody:
Replace verbose command-by-command transcripts with data-driven fixtures
and a deterministic batch runner. This preserves exact-output coverage
while reducing repeated context and execution time.

Update the UI-testing skill and project instructions to report only counts
on success and retain detailed evidence for failures.

Restrict course-site browsing to requirement interpretation, verification,
ambiguity resolution, and explicit user requests.

Keep routine implementation, debugging, and testing grounded in local
instructions while excluding previous-semester sources.
